text.p: BFI up three to 1,337 points on Thursday.
Cargill were reported to have paid a significantly higher $23.50 no combo for Torm Tekla 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan July 25/Aug 3 which surprised some brokers in view of the forward dates.
There were rumours Hanjin also covered a similar positton but details were lacking.
Cargill quoted another US Gulf to Japan stem for July 14/20.

Brokers reported busy trading in Panamaxes from Argentina and Brazil to the Far East for July although some doubts have been raised about quantities destined for China due to alleged letter of credit problems.
Dreyfus fixed the NSAC vessel Great Dove for 54,000 heavy grain Brazil to Taiwan for July 16 cancelling at a firmer $24.25.
The Baltic Handy Index was unchanged at 1,017 points.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was between 35 and 25 points higher and turnover totalled 94 lots.
